text_to_image_prompt: Create an environment-only 公寓 · 户型图. One single-storey cream and warm wood apartment. Northwest narrow sage galley kitchen, central living dining room with blue grey sofa against east wall and television on west wall, dining by north skyline window; bedroom east with bedhead east; entry hall south linking all rooms via open passages including west kitchen vestibule. Three north windows with cream curtains and radiators. Compact bath southeast. Views retain this coherent layout and relative scale. No humans, animals, fabricated dimensions or slogans.
original_prompt: Edit this concept floor plan ONLY in two local details. 1. Change the circular A label inside central living room to B (legend already correctly says B living, A kitchen). 2. At SOUTHWEST of living room, connect small kitchen entry vestibule to main entry hall: remove blocking short vertical wall between kitchen vestibule and hall at its lower/southern end and create a clearly visible OPEN PASSAGE with continuous floor. Kitchen door must lead via vestibule into main hall, not an isolated box. Keep kitchen west, living center, bedroom east, all furnishings, windows, apartment footprint, typography, palette and all other geometry unchanged. No people.

reproduction_note: 根据原场景生成并逐张目视检查的概念空间资料；未展示区域属于设计推演，图间可能存在细节差异；不是实测施工图或可编辑三维模型。独立提示词未经过逐张重生成复现验证。
reference_guided_prompt:
Use case: infographic-diagram / spatial production design.
Asset: Vicky environment library, scene-001-01, 公寓, 户型图. Generate one finished independent image, landscape 1536x1024 or larger.
Input image 1 is the existing environment identity reference. ALL six panels depict ONE apartment: living/dining, kitchen, bedroom, entrance. Preserve bluegrey sofa by right wall, dining beside large skyline window, green kitchen cabinets, wood floor. Establish coherent apartment layout connecting rooms.
Any additional reference is the same scene's concept floor/site plan and is the geometric source of truth. Keep its footprint, entrances, openings, adjacencies, landmark arrangement and orientation fixed.
Request: One clean orthographic overhead floor plan or outdoor site plan, not a perspective view. Show the whole coherent spatial footprint: wall thickness, doors and swing arcs, windows, stairs, furniture footprints, connected zones, entrances and circulation. For landscape/city locations show terrain, paths, water edges, bridges and building footprints instead of inventing a generic house. Top of sheet is NORTH (design orientation, not measured geography). Discreet zone names and numbered landmark keys A B C D, scale relationships readable but NO fabricated metric dimensions. Label as CONCEPT PLAN. Use solid outlines for source-evidenced elements and dashed outlines for newly inferred unseen boundaries. One plan large on page, compact legend, no decorative thumbnails.
Maintain the architecture, distinctive objects, material vocabulary and visual character of the original. Do not reuse the reference board as the output. Rationally extrapolate only unseen geometry; it is a coherent concept reconstruction for story staging, not surveyed construction documentation. Use one internally consistent space, not a collage of unrelated rooms. Walls meet logically, doors connect traversable spaces, no blocked entrances or impossible staircases. NO people, NO characters, NO animals, NO silhouettes, NO human figures in reflections or posters, NO logos/watermarks. Small legible English labels only where useful. Avoid busy ornament, repeated generic layouts and unexplained disconnected rooms.
Original design context (use only details compatible with target reference panel): 捡到的黑猫 · 公寓六视角 · 纯环境修订
